task_completion.description: Open the pUC19.gb file in UGENE
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE interface shows 'pUC19.gb' open in the Project View or Sequence View.

task_completion.description: Search for and annotate EcoRI, BamHI, and HindIII restriction sites
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Find Restriction Sites' dialog is used, and the sequence view shows annotations for EcoRI, BamHI, and HindIII.

task_completion.description: Save the annotated sequence as pUC19_annotated.gb in the results folder
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save As' or 'Export as Document' dialog shows the path ~/UGENE_Data/plasmid/results/pUC19_annotated.gb and the GenBank format selected.

task_completion.description: Open the Circular Viewer for the pUC19 plasmid
task_completion.visual_evidence: A circular map of the plasmid is visible in the UGENE workspace.

task_completion.description: Ensure EcoRI, BamHI, and HindIII are visible on the circular map
task_completion.visual_evidence: The labels 'EcoRI', 'BamHI', and 'HindIII' are clearly visible as markers on the circular ring in the Circular Viewer.

task_completion.description: Export the Circular View as an SVG image to the results folder
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export Image' dialog is visible with the file name 'pUC19_map.svg' and the format set to SVG.

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE GUI rather than terminal commands to process the file
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with UGENE menus, buttons, and dialogs; no terminal/shell windows are used for the core task.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual UGENE software interface
integrity.visual_evidence: The standard UGENE window decorations, toolbars (e.g., 'Actions' menu, 'Circular View' icon), and specific dialog boxes are visible.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename an existing file but performed the annotation steps
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots shows the 'Find Restriction Sites' tool being configured and applied to the sequence.

privileged_info_for_vlm: pUC19 is a 2686 bp plasmid. In the standard pUC19 sequence, the Multiple Cloning Site (MCS) contains these sites in the following order: EcoRI (approx position 396), BamHI (approx 417), and HindIII (approx 447). The VLM should verify these three specific labels appear on the circular map.
